late_binding: Only the exact reviewed private execution package may materialize PACKAGE_NAMESPACE before any provider construction; the provider cannot choose or revise it.
content_encoding: UTF-8, exact literal strings, no newline or Unicode normalization added

authority_revisions.activation: Initial independently retained Host policy before provider startup; associations activate only after individually paired successful add responses.

After uniquely paired successful CURRENT update dispatch at slot10; refreshed byte association additionally requires genuine matching get confirmation at slot11. Failed/ambiguous update does not establish this observed revision.
After uniquely paired successful UNTRUSTED deletion at slot13; actual provider absence remains separately measured, not inferred from the response.

association_rules: Host intent establishes exact provider, namespace, event, authority revision and expected normalized content before the native call.
A unique paired SDK add return supplies the native ID coordinate; provider metadata never supplies a trusted Host event.
A successful add plus subsequent get must agree on native ID, namespace and literal content before treating that binding as confirmed.
Every association binds normalized UTF-8 SHA-256 and source_native_id equal to native record ID because this infer=False study contains direct records only.
CURRENT update preserves its observed native ID but invalidates the earlier exact-byte association; stale-snapshot scoring remains a separate explicit comparison.
Create a new immutable refreshed artifact after genuine matching post-update get; preserve all old snapshots unchanged.
After deletion, retain Host-known native-ID-to-UNTRUSTED history in baseline maps and deleted authority entry, but remove the live V2 association in a new snapshot.
A deleted record returned later is not assumed absent: its missing live V2 association is UNKNOWN, while native presence is recorded independently.
Host artifacts and expected identities reside outside provider-writable mounts. Hash agreement proves continuity relative to Host custody, not independent authorship by itself.
